sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:64

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:64:1
items.html: It magnified the Kli of Keter and extended through opposite the place of Sium of the entire Tifferet. It means that afterwards, when it rose to it with the Reshimot de Gevurot of the Daat, as the Rav says below, a Zivug was made anew on the Hassadim and Gevurot of the Daat, and then the Kelim from the Chazeh downward grew.
